title: Overnight C2/C5/ODST Failure-Mechanism and Rescue Campaign
manuscript: Teacher-Anchored Differentiable Sequence–Ensemble Learning for Explainable Insider Threat Detection

priority: prefer simpler formulation when performance is effectively tied
promotion_rule.if_none_beat_c2: promote up to two closest mechanistically distinct candidates only if diagnostics suggest a plausible fix rather than noise

annealed_schedule_formula.formula: w(e) = w0 * (MAX_EPOCHS - e) / (MAX_EPOCHS - 1)  for e in {1,...,MAX_EPOCHS}

class_balanced_anchor_formula.description: Keep producing per-window logit/route terms; replace reduction with equal average of positive-window mean and negative-window mean so benign count cannot dominate.
class_balanced_anchor_formula.formula: L_bal = 0.5 * mean(term | y=1) + 0.5 * mean(term | y=0) when both classes present in the batch; otherwise the producing mean over the present class.

selective_anchoring_rule.rule: On TRAIN only, using frozen teacher logits and the frozen producing teacher validation-F1 threshold for that seed: teacher_pred = (sigmoid(teacher_logit) >= teacher_threshold); anchor_mask = (teacher_pred == y_train). Logit and route terms are averaged only over masked windows. Empty-mask batches skip the anchor terms.
selective_anchoring_rule.not_an_invented_class_rule: Reuses the producing inference threshold already frozen per teacher seed.

residual_odst_definition.initial_residual: ODST leaf_responses initialised at zeros so odst_residual_logit starts at 0; initial prediction equals the frozen attention-linear logit.
residual_odst_definition.r7: Load frozen attention-linear encoder+attention+linear; freeze encoder+attention+linear; train ODST residual only.
residual_odst_definition.r8: Execute if R7 improves validation PR-AUC or shows clear training headroom without catastrophic overfit; unfreeze encoder+attention+linear under existing LR discipline; no teacher anchoring.
residual_odst_definition.r9: Execute only if (R7 or R8 shows predictive headroom) AND (R3/R4 indicates annealed anchoring preferable to constant C5 anchoring).

r10_route_matching_rule.assignment: Hungarian minimisation of mean-squared teacher-vs-student per-tree output difference on a frozen TRAIN diagnostic subset (seed=42, first 4096 TRAIN windows after the producing shuffle seed). Assignment computed once at initialisation and frozen for the run. Layer-wise independent (8 trees per Dense layer).

historical_reuse_policy.B0_C2: Reuse frozen C2 checkpoints/metrics if SHA-256 matches EDITOR-006A allow-list; do not retrain unless identity mismatch.
historical_reuse_policy.B1_C5_original_paper: Reuse frozen C5_original_paper checkpoints/metrics if SHA-256 matches EDITOR-006A allow-list. NEVER use ablation-retrained C5.
historical_reuse_policy.R1_logit_only: Historical C3 is the exact authorised condition; reuse frozen C3 seed-42 (and full seeds if promoted) when checkpoint hashes are recorded.
historical_reuse_policy.R2_route_only: Historical C4 is the exact authorised condition; reuse analogously.
historical_reuse_policy.random_init_anchoring: Historical C6 is the authorised random-init + anchoring condition; reuse for collapse forensics; do not retrain unless saved evidence is insufficient for required diagnostics.

B1.name: Current C5_original_paper reproduction
B1.purpose: exact present method; identity is C5_original_paper not ablation C5

R1.name: Logit anchoring only
R1.purpose: isolate whether route anchoring suppresses predictive improvement

R3.name: Annealed anchoring
R3.schedule: EDITOR009_LINEAR_EPOCH_DECAY_TO_ZERO for both logit and route
R3.purpose: stabilise early; permit supervised departure late

R4.name: Annealed logit only
R4.purpose: separate beneficial teacher stabilisation from route constraint

R5.name: Teacher-correct selective anchoring
R5.purpose: allow the student more freedom where the teacher is wrong

R6.name: Class-balanced anchoring
R6.purpose: test whether severe imbalance makes anchoring a benign-preservation penalty

R7.name: Residual ODST head-only
R7.purpose: is there nonlinear residual signal beyond the linear head?

R8.name: Residual ODST end-to-end
R8.conditional: R7 improves validation PR-AUC or exhibits clear training headroom without catastrophic overfit

R9.name: Residual ODST + annealed teacher anchoring
R9.conditional: (R7 or R8 headroom) AND (R3/R4 annealed preferable to constant C5)

hard_blocks: input hash mismatch affecting scientific identity
training code cannot reproduce C2/C5 semantics
